notes: George "Export" as CSV with the fields of the documented example: Buchungsdatum, Valutadatum, Betrag, the Partner block (name, IBAN, BIC, account number, bank code) and Buchungstext; separator ";", no quotes, Währung not ticked so no currency is named. UTF-16LE with a byte-order mark (FF FE) and CRLF. dd.mm.yyyy, a signed Betrag in Austrian/German format with dot thousands and a comma decimal; newest first. George lets the user pick fields, order, separator and quotes, so files vary; the Partner sub-column names are reconstructed. No balance.
